# Plans Need Data

<!-- STEP id="family" -->
A family plans its money. Some goes to things it must have, like food, medicines and school supplies. Some goes to things it would like, such as a meal out. Some is saved.

<!-- STEP id="data" -->
Governments plan how to spend tax money on roads, schools and welfare. Enterprises (farms, shops and firms) study what customers buy before they make more. Good plans use **data**: facts and numbers collected for study. Much data comes from **surveys**, which collect and study facts in a planned way.

**Good decisions rely on data, not guesswork.**
